notes: Live Shopify store (francfrancjp.myshopify.com), direct fetch worked, no Claude-specific robots.txt disallow. Full category tree pulled from /pages/category_list (accordion nav + footer 3-level tree-menu + embedded header-menu JSON, which agree with each other). Every qty is an exhaustive unique-product-ID count via /collections/<handle>/products.json?limit=250 pagination (Rule 1), not the inflated products_count field. Hierarchy: Mirrors ('mirror' handle) is reachable both from the Interior Goods nav group (as parent of wall/stand/tabletop mirror) and from the Bath & Beauty nav group as a flat item -- same URL, counted once, no double-count (Rule 0.6). Translated all Japanese category names to plain English per project discipline. EXCLUSIONS applied (with title-level verification, Rule re: mixed roll-ups): candle_holder's 'candle' child (1 item, LED Christmas snowman candle, out of stock) dropped as Holiday & Gift, not everyday decor. Art's 'hook' (1, wall-mount hook hardware) and 'wall_stickers' (9, removable wallpaper) children dropped as hardware/wallpaper. Object & Decoration branch (object_decoration, 485 raw) dropped ENTIRELY: its 'garden'-adjacent siblings tree/lease/ornament/dried_flower are Christmas-tree/wreath/ornament holiday decor and artificial_flower (301 items) is explicitly excluded faux flowers; its own 'object' sub-collection (72 items) was inspected title-by-title and is a heavily mixed roll-up -- 26/72 (36%) are removable-wallpaper products mistagged into it, and most of the remainder are Christmas snow globes, Nordic Santa figurines, and tree-topper ornaments; only a handful of genuine non-holiday decor objects remain, not enough to justify padding a category (drop, don't pad). garden_goods (11, garden decor) excluded as garden. interior_strage/kitchen_strage (215, storage) excluded as storage. Kitchen goods scoped to Kitchen & Dining per brief: cutlery (320) excluded explicitly; cookware/kitchen-tool/wine-bar-tool/food-storage clusters (kitchen_scale_measure, kitchen_sponge_brush, soy_sauce, seasoning_bowl, hot_pot, vinegar_bottle, kitchen_trash_can, cutting_board, pots_pans, rice_scoop, frying_pan_pot_set, kitchen_knife, ladle_turner, slicer_peeler, tongs, microwave_utensils, muddler, bottle_stopper, water_drain_mat, bottle, lunch_box, pitcher) excluded as cookware/bar-tools/food-storage; table linens (table_center -- verified via titles to be fabric table RUNNERS, not centerpiece objects -- plus tablecloth, placemat, napkin/dish-cloth cluster, apron) excluded as textiles; coaster (92) excluded, grouped with the same functional table-linen-protector cluster as placemat/napkin. Stationery cluster (bookend, accessory_case/desk-tray, pen_case, under Fashion Goods > Stationery) excluded as office/desk organizers, not decorative accessories. No decorative-lighting-by-room breakdown exists on this site; 'light' is a single flat collection (82 items, verified genuine lamps/floor lamps via title sample) with no further site-defined sub-nodes, so it is emitted as one childless leaf per the hierarchy exception. desktop_accessories is a genuine standalone site category currently showing 0 live products (verified via empty products.json), included with qty 0 as a real (not uncertain) answer. Not a flagged duplicate-company case (Francfranc does not appear on the S.N.196-220 duplicate list) and no closure/retirement signals -- site fully live.
